study_design: Matched case-control analysis using serum collected before prostate cancer diagnosis
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Levels of dehydroepiandrosterone (DHEA) and dehydroepiandrosterone sulfate (DHEA-S) in sera collected and frozen in 1974 were studied among 81 prostate cancer cases diagnosed in the following 12 years and 81 age- and race-matched controls.
reason: Prediagnostic serum DHEA was evaluated in 81 subsequently diagnosed prostate cancer cases and 81 matched controls. The abstract addresses overall prostate cancer and provides no aggressive disease definition or analysis.

estimate_classifications.reason: The row concerns subsequent overall prostate cancer, without an aggressive subtype. The abstract reports no effect estimate with both 95% confidence bounds.
